title: Atlas Measurement Tolerance Profile Schema
description: Schema for the versioned tolerance profile used in measurement reconciliation and accuracy gates. See design section 21.2.

version.description: Profile version in semantic versioning format (e.g. 1.0.0). A breaking threshold change increments the major or minor version; editions stay immutable.

description.description: Human-readable description of this profile version.

rows.description: Tolerance threshold rows used in the tolerance function.

name.description: Unique name of the threshold row.

purpose.description: Human-readable purpose of this row (e.g. 'QA gate', 'Comparison classification').

description.description: Detailed description of how this row is used.

floorM.description: Absolute floor tolerance in metres. Part of tol = max(floorM, relFrac * ref, ...).

relFrac.description: Relative tolerance as a fraction of the reference value. Part of tol = max(floorM, relFrac * ref, ...).

sigmaK.description: Sigma multiplier for the combined uncertainty term. null means the sigma term is omitted from the tolerance function. Part of tol = max(..., min(sigmaK * combinedSigma, sigmaCapM)).

sigmaCapM.description: Cap on the sigma term in metres. null means no cap. Used only if sigmaK is non-null.

overrides.description: Per-algorithmMajor overrides of the rows above. Keys are algorithmMajor version numbers (e.g. '1', '2'); values are objects with the same structure as rows, overriding only the fields specified.

additionalProperties.description: Override values for a specific algorithmMajor.

notes.description: Informational notes about the profile (algorithm, comparison semantics, versioning policy, etc.).
